title: CLIP-Lite: Information Efficient Visual Representation Learning with Language Supervision

bias_targets.methodology: Identifying a gender subspace in the shared vision-language latent space using gendered word pairs (e.g., man/woman, son/daughter), projecting and subtracting this variance to create neutralized image representations, and evaluating the impact by comparing alignment scores between gendered text prompts and images from male and female subsets of the COCO dataset.
